hero.lead: The tool below pulls live market fares from airline distribution feeds for any route you specify. Enter your margin rules and it shows you the resulting price — and exactly where that price sits against everything else currently selling on that route.

steps.heading: Live fares from distribution feeds
steps.body: Fares are pulled in real time from airline distribution systems for the route and travel dates you specify. There is no cached data and no manual input — what you see is what is selling right now.

steps.heading: Your margin rules applied automatically
steps.body: The tool applies your configured margin rules per channel — wholesale, retail, corporate, or direct. Adjustments are calculated automatically so you are not doing arithmetic in a spreadsheet.

steps.heading: Position against the full market
steps.body: The result shows where your priced fare sits against the full range of fares currently available on that route — market low, midpoint, and high. You see the competitive position before you commit.

access.heading: Request agent access
access.intro: Access is available to accredited travel agencies and airline revenue teams. Submit your details and we will be in touch within one business day.
access.success_body: We will review your details and follow up within one business day.
access.footnote: We do not share your details with third parties.
